name: Internexa Arequipa - Socabaya
notes: Baxtel lists Internexa Arequipa - Socabaya as a fully operational data center in Arequipa; PeeringDB identifies the InterNexa Peru facility in Arequipa with company website and location details.

name: PIT Peru Arequipa - AQP1
notes: ColoMap lists PIT Peru Arequipa - AQP1 as a colocation data center at Calle Jacinto Ibanez 148, Arequipa; PCH lists the associated PIT Arequipa exchange as active and established in 2021.

name: DIRESA Cajamarca Data Center
developer: Direccion Regional de Salud Cajamarca / Compania Minera Coimolache support
notes: DCD reported in 2018 that DIRESA Cajamarca's data-center building was 80% advanced with about 1 million soles investment; Andina reported on 2024-01-08 that the data center was being implemented to support electronic clinical histories and telemedicine across regional health establishments.

name: Corte Superior del Callao Data Center
developer: Corte Superior de Justicia del Callao
notes: DCD reported the Callao court implemented a data center for continuity of judicial IT services, including power, backup power, cooling, cabling, fire detection/suppression, leak detection, security controls, and civil works at the Av. Colonial site.

name: Gobierno Regional de Cusco regional data center projects
notes: Andina reported two implementation routes for a regional data center in Cusco: one as part of the technical file for the new regional government headquarters, and a larger privately financed data center intended to serve public entities and more than 100 districts.

name: Minsa Huancavelica regional health data center
notes: DCD reported that Peru's Ministry of Health planned three additional large data centers in strategic regions including Huancavelica, with total investment around 500 million soles across Lima, Trujillo, and Huancavelica.
